_comment: The capture registry: every Virginia institution the CS scrape visits.
One row per institution, keyed by the same slug the requirement documents
use (`va:as:<slug>:cs` / `va:degree:<slug>:cs`), so a row here and a row in
`catalog_root` and `platform` were probed live, not assumed — see the
`probed` stamp. `platform` decides the transport: acalog needs the browser,
`pdf` / `web` are the institutions that publish no catalog software at all.
`seeds` are known-good starting URLs. They are a hint, never the answer:
acalog poids go stale every catalog year, so capture rediscovers on the
newest catoid and only falls back to the seed. `role` separates the major
requirements page from the general-education page, because a four-year
degree's full graduation requirements usually span both.
`offers_cs: false` is a recorded finding, not an absence — it means the
catalog was read and no CS degree was there.
`cohorts.schev_public_four_year` is the primary public receiving scope.
Institutions outside it remain in this registry as secondary research;
cohort membership changes display/filter priority, never data retention.
